summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Random Events / Secret Missions feature. All 37 backend tests pass (1 skipped). Random event lifecycle fully functional: generation with public daily observance theme, schedule-aware prompting, 1 active mission per user rule, accept/dismiss flow, XP award on completion, and pair/team follow-up events.

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility issue (pre-existing from iteration 3)

critical_code_review_comments: Random event generation correctly fetches public daily observance from https://todaysholiday.herokuapp.com/holidays/{month}/{day}
Schedule-aware prompting: is_user_available_for_prompt() correctly checks user's availability window before generating new events
Accepted events remain visible even outside availability window (correct behavior)
1 active mission per user rule enforced via get_active_random_event_for_user()
Accept/dismiss flow correctly updates participant status without XP penalty for dismissal
Complete flow awards XP and updates user progression (points and level)
Pair/team follow-up: create_follow_up_random_events() creates simplified follow-up for pending/dismissed participants
RandomEventBubble.jsx has all required data-testid attributes for testing

success_rate.frontend: 100% (RandomEventBubble component verified with correct data-testid attributes)

test_credentials: None required - tests create fresh households
seed_data_creation: Test households created with unique names during pytest runs
